regions.label: INesHeader
regions.evidence: Parsed iNES header establishes mapper4, PRG/CHR lengths, trainer absent; immutable metadata workspace.json and baseline inspection.

regions.label: ChrPatternRom
regions.evidence: Header-bounded CHR ROM. NES PPU 2bpp planar 16-byte pattern tiles; physically distinct from CPU executable PRG. Inspected header, region limits and startup rendered title. Semantic tile grouping unresolved.

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Three little-endian hardware vector words in final PRG bank: NMI E1AE, reset E000, IRQ E3B4. Targets independently inspected, coherent interrupt/reset contracts; vector-*.json.

regions.label: MenuHandlerReturnTargets
regions.evidence: Bank2 CPU8AB1..8ABE contains seven little-endian return-minus-one target words. Selector RAM9D wraps in 0..6 (INC then CMP#07/reset, decrement wraps6) at physical4A3E..4A58; consumer doubles9D and pushes high/low bytes from8AB2,X/8AB1,X then RTS at4AB1..4ABD. Independent 7-selector domain proves14-byte extent. Preceding JMP ends4AC1; following PLA begins4ACF. menu-selector.json/menu-dispatch.json. Static table role; all selectors natural reachability not asserted.
